title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: LLM-assisted drafting introduces specific failure mode: text fluent citation real, cited source actually support specific claim made. statistic gets slightly wrong, finding gets overgeneralised, number migrates one paper another. cred provides systematic workflow catch . citation bookdown report, locates source document, finds best-matching passage, flags claims need human review.

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_aud_write() — scan Rmd files, extract every @citekey paraphrase context, write CSV scaffold. crd_zot_src_lookup() — query local Zotero SQLite find PDF/docx paths citation key. crd_aud_verify_all() — source, load fill quote, page_or_section, verified matching rows. (Wraps steps 2 + 4.) crd_aud_sort() — sort status (auto first) reviewable rows come first. crd_aud_summary() — print status snapshot attachment priority list. Open CSV Excel spreadsheet app. auto row: read quote, compare paraphrase, set verified yes, , corrected.
code: Rmd files  →  audit CSV  →  Zotero lookup  →  auto-fill quotes  →  sort  →  review

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: cred ships toy source files minimal Zotero SQLite inst/extdata/:
code: inst/extdata/ ├── zotero.sqlite                         # toy Zotero DB (3 items, 2 with attachments) └── storage/     ├── TOYPDF1/salmon_habitat.pdf        # PDF: Smith et al. 2020     └── TOYDOC1/beaver_ecology.docx       # docx: Jones 2019 library(cred)  toy_zotero_dir <- system.file("extdata", package = "cred")

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_aud_write() scans chapter Rmd files (beginning four digits) extracts every citation surrounding sentence paraphrase. Six rows: three citation keys (smith2020SalmonHabitat, doe2021NoFile, jones2019BeaverEcology), appearing one three times.
code: # Create two toy Rmd files in a temp directory rmd_dir <- tempfile("rmd_") dir.create(rmd_dir)  writeLines(c(   "# Habitat Quality {#habitat}",   "",   "Spawning gravel embeddedness is the primary metric for assessing habitat",   "quality for chinook salmon [@smith2020SalmonHabitat].",   "",   "Riparian vegetation provides critical shade that moderates summer",   "stream temperatures by 3--7 degrees [@smith2020SalmonHabitat].",   "",   "Stream temperature affects the spatial distribution of salmon across",   "the watershed [@doe2021NoFile]." ), file.path(rmd_dir, "0100-habitat.Rmd"))  writeLines(c(   "# Beaver Ecology {#beaver}",   "",   "Beaver dams increase overwinter survival of juvenile salmonids by",   "creating slow-water refuges with stable thermal conditions",   "[@jones2019BeaverEcology].",   "",   "Reintroduction of beavers reduces peak flows and extends summer",   "baseflows [@jones2019BeaverEcology].",   "",   "Beaver removal reduced pond habitat extent by 60% between 1850 and",   "1950 [@jones2019BeaverEcology]." ), file.path(rmd_dir, "0200-beaver.Rmd"))  audit_file <- tempfile("citation_audit_", fileext = ".csv")  crd_aud_write(rmd_dir = rmd_dir, out_file = audit_file) #> Scanning: 0100-habitat.Rmd #> Scanning: 0200-beaver.Rmd #> Wrote 6 rows to /tmp/RtmpRcY41m/citation_audit_1cfd263cf7dc.csv d <- readr::read_csv(audit_file, show_col_types = FALSE) knitr::kable(d[, c("section", "citation_key", "paraphrase", "verified")])

what: Step 2: Look up Zotero source paths
title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_zot_src_lookup() queries Zotero SQLite database PDF docx attachment key. uses immutable read-URI avoid locking running Zotero process. doe2021NoFile attachment toy database (metadata-entry), warned excluded. real workflow list PDFs need attach Zotero can auto-verified.
code: keys <- unique(d$citation_key)  sources <- crd_zot_src_lookup(keys, zotero_dir = toy_zotero_dir) #> Warning in crd_zot_src_lookup(keys, zotero_dir = toy_zotero_dir): No attachment #> found in Zotero for: doe2021NoFile print(sources) #> # A tibble: 2 × 3 #>   citation_key           src_path                                       src_type #>   <chr>                  <chr>                                          <chr>    #> 1 jones2019BeaverEcology /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/cred/extdata/… docx     #> 2 smith2020SalmonHabitat /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/cred/extdata/… pdf

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_aud_verify_all() loads source document , every unverified row matching citation key, searches document using paraphrase query. fills: quote — best-matching passage page_or_section — paragraph index (docx) page number (pdf) verified — "auto" score ≥ min_score; "no_match" otherwise sources argument optional — omitted, function runs crd_zot_src_lookup() automatically. Rows citing doe2021NoFile remain NA source file exists. Rows citing smith2020SalmonHabitat jones2019BeaverEcology filled matching passages.
code: crd_aud_verify_all(   audit_file = audit_file,   sources    = sources   # pass pre-looked-up sources to skip re-querying SQLite ) #> [1/2] Loading source for jones2019BeaverEcology (docx) ... #> Filling 3 rows for jones2019BeaverEcology ... #> Done — 1 filled, 2 no_match #> [2/2] Loading source for smith2020SalmonHabitat (pdf) ... #> Filling 2 rows for smith2020SalmonHabitat ... #> Done — 2 filled, 0 no_match d2 <- readr::read_csv(audit_file, show_col_types = FALSE) knitr::kable(d2[, c("citation_key", "paraphrase", "quote", "page_or_section", "verified")])

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_aud_sort() rearranges rows make manual review efficient. "status" sort puts auto rows (quotes ready check) first NA rows (nothing review) last. sort_index set write time never changes — use crd_aud_sort(= "report") restore original report order time.
code: crd_aud_sort(audit_file, by = "status") #> Sorted by 'status' and wrote 6 rows to /tmp/RtmpRcY41m/citation_audit_1cfd263cf7dc.csv d3 <- readr::read_csv(audit_file, show_col_types = FALSE) knitr::kable(d3[, c("citation_key", "verified", "sort_index")])

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_aud_summary() lists sources NA status ranked claim count. highest-priority Zotero attachment targets — attaching one PDF can unlock many rows . Zotero: Find item (citation key citation_key column) Right-click → Add Attachment → Attach File Re-run crd_aud_verify_all() — newly attached files picked automatically

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: token scoring approach intentionally simple fast: Strip @citekey patterns markdown punctuation paraphrase Split tokens (≥ 4 characters) paragraph/page source, compute score = proportion query tokens found Accept top-scoring passage score ≥ min_score (default 0.2) works well specific factual claims (statistics, named findings). produces no_match : narrative synthesis text (direct quote exists) Highly paraphrased claims phrasing diverges source Compound [@; @b] citations paraphrase attributed jointly no_match error — means row needs manual verification.

title: Citation Review and Evidence Documentation
Citation Review and Evidence Documentation
text: 1. Generate audit CSV — one row per citation, surrounding sentence paraphrase: 2. Auto-fill quotes source documents — queries local Zotero database PDF/docx attachments, searches one best-matching passage, fills quote, page_or_section, verified = "auto": 3. Check progress — see status breakdown PDFs attach Zotero unlock rows: 4. Sort review session — auto rows (quotes ready check) first, NA rows (source file) last: 5. Open CSV Excel, read quote vs paraphrase, set verified yes / / corrected. done reviewing, restore report order:
code: Rmd files  →  audit CSV  →  Zotero lookup  →  auto-fill quotes  →  sort  →  review crd_aud_write(rmd_dir = ".", out_file = "background/citation_audit.csv") crd_aud_verify_all("background/citation_audit.csv") crd_aud_summary("background/citation_audit.csv") crd_aud_sort("background/citation_audit.csv", by = "status") crd_aud_sort("background/citation_audit.csv", by = "report")

text: line character(1) single line Rmd prose. key character(1) BBT citation key (without leading @). min_chars integer(1) minimum fragment length falling back full line. Default 40L.

title: Extract the sentence(s) containing a specific citation key — crd_sent_ext_key
text: character(1) trimmed sentence fragment, full line fragment uninformative.

title: Extract the sentence(s) containing a specific citation key — crd_sent_ext_key
text: Split rules (applied outside [...] citation bracket groups): . [Capital] — period followed capital letter, excluding common abbreviations (et al., Dr., Mr., St.). . @key — period followed narrative citation, sentences form @author documented... correctly isolated. lookahead (?![^[]*\]) prevents splitting inside [@k1; @k2] checking ] reachable without first crossing [.

title: Extract the sentence(s) containing a specific citation key — crd_sent_ext_key
code: line <- paste(   "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y.",   "@brown2022 extended the finding." ) crd_sent_ext_key(line, "jones2021") #> [1] "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y." crd_sent_ext_key(line, "brown2022") #> [1] "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y. @brown2022 extended the finding."
